author: Elizabeth Ahlgren
text:
There was a bad batch that happened, at least in the US. Abbott knew and recalled them by serial #. In my shipment of 8, I had 3 that were faulty and they were replaced. Be patient and contact customer service. 
Save the bad ones. Abbott sends a box for you to return them.

author: Bobby Bob
text: I had a series of libre sensors failed as well. I used libre 2 for about over 4 years without problems and in the last year I have increasing instances of sensors not passing the 1 hr initialization.
